_comment: any2bazel parity configuration for the Bazel build of dnf5 (@dnf5, see
bazel/dnf5/dnf5.BUILD.bazel) against the upstream CMake build configured by
tools/any2bazel/reference_configure.sh. Rationale for every entry is in

_rationale.exclude_targets: automatic and needs-restarting need sdbus-c++/systemd, which are out of scope for a portable build; they are configured in the reference only because they cannot be switched off. rpmdb-mark is a command plugin of this repository (//bazel/dnf5/plugins), not of upstream, so the CMake reference has no counterpart. Its sources live in the main repository, outside @dnf5, so the diff attributes them to no target and reports them as 2 extra_tu warnings.
_rationale.target_map: Bazel keys targets by label; @dnf5 is created by the dnf5_extension module extension.
_rationale.dep_map.dnf5-cli: libdnf5-cli is linked as a shared library on both sides; CMake spells it as a library name, Bazel as -l:libdnf5-cli.so.3.
_rationale.dep_map.stdc++: Upstream links libstdc++ explicitly (for clang); the hermetic LLVM toolchain uses libc++ on every platform.
_rationale.dep_map.*->dnf5-deps: Every third-party library (fmt, json-c, libpkgmanifest, popt, librpm*, libsmartcols, zlib, ...) is linked into one in-project shared object, libdnf5-deps, instead of separate system shared libraries; see the THIRD_PARTY list in bazel/dnf5/dnf5.BUILD.bazel.
_rationale.defines.PROJECT_*_DIR: Absolute build/source paths of the reference container; only used by the test suite, which is not built.
_rationale.defines.*_EXPORTS: Added by CMake to every shared library target and to executables with ENABLE_EXPORTS (dnf5); not referenced by the dnf5 sources.
_rationale.flags.-Werror: Upstream's warnings-as-errors policy is tuned for GCC; this build uses clang (where it would only add clang-specific breakage) and the repository's global -w. It does not change generated code.
_rationale.flags.-Wl,--as-needed: Upstream adds this linker flag as a compile option (a no-op when compiling) and only for non-clang compilers.
_rationale.flags_prefixes.-fmacro-prefix-map=: Both sides strip the source root from __FILE__; the spelling of the root differs (/src vs the external repository path).
_rationale.include_prefixes./usr/include/sysprof-6: Part of glib-2.0's pkg-config cflags on Fedora (optional sysprof tracing support); not used by dnf5 nor by the BCR glib.
_rationale.include_map: pkg-config include roots of system libraries vs the include roots of the corresponding Bazel modules.
_rationale.link_flags.-DNDEBUG: CMake repeats the RelWithDebInfo compile flags on the link line, where -DNDEBUG has no effect.
